notes.title: 0713 Update
notes.notes:
Yesterday, because an alien entered our studio and deleted a key file, some updated players got stuck in the loading interface. We rolled back to the previous version yesterday and fixed the problem today. The alien apologized for this and promised us that it would never invade the earth。

In addition, the following known problems have been modified:

The display problem of "lucky lady is smiling" event.

The bug that happens occasionally after the monster becomes the head teacher.

The price of torch has been lowered（ Now 40 gold coins)

If a player goes to the toilet in the process of "ferrule game", the game may get stuck when he comes back.

The tree will not drop seeds due to continuous damage such as poisoning and bleeding.

notes.title: Summer Update is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we put all the energy on the develop in this period, the big update is almost done. Now we will invite several players to test this update, and then make the update partly. Because of our fans’ encouragement and suggestions, Big Bia can be improved all the times, so we wanna more players can join us, to make Big Bia a better game.

New mode- Conquer the Microcosm (Tentative)
Each “Microcosm” has its own single map which shows special NPC and locations, these elements can be interactive, players success in this map can get special metal to unlock rarity toys.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/661f070448f22496cdd9949de9bb6a97d5123988.png
Infinity Mode
Players can choose infinity mode when entering the dungeon creator. In the infinity mode, players will contentiously enter random scenes and meet challenges. There will be lots of cards only shown in this mode.

Everyday Challenge (Beta test will be update in our BIT)
Players can take infinity challenge in “Monster lad”, improve self with operation and choices to face harder challenges. Players can use the same accompany and special rules to climb the rank, and unlock special toys. The rank will be updated everyday.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/907ce9ceabb372007fbb19db216a99c41b0184d4.png

My Toy Box
All the toys you get from each mode can be put in here, you can even joint them into your own world.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/b5144cad96a06ee936ce750943cfc0605bdfb96a.png

notes.title: Big Bia EA version description
notes.notes:
1. Combation of Nine different dungeons
In addition tot he Forest, Circus and Volcano showed in the Demo version. EA version of the game added: Maple Forest, Desert, Game Company, Worm Nest, Internet Cafe, and Dungeon.
There will be multiple Exits generated in each map level. Players can choose which scene to enter in the next level according to their own situation. The total number of levels is adjusted to 4 with each level map being smaller. （Pictures shown are not final）

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/917c8e6c806b0c2390440757aca42278c1f9b500.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/f5b4efb67324a2a57c8c263980b13cc589227303.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/544f422e0ae75fb0eda2cd96e50ca94ce818ca2e.png

Three bosses are optimized to simplify the lengthy of the skill description and add a “Boss core” to the battle field to clarify the Boss attack intention.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/59a620e0c036d26ba8d6583311de7a8867111e02.png

2. The story generation system and Flatten the boss with a “Bia”
In the Ea version of the game, some interesting content will be generated and displayed in the adventure Log during the player’s journey. It will content the events and battles on the journey to make it more immersive and fun for players. However,  if players who do not like the story and events, they can choose to ignore it and it wont affect the flow of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/4321b03e6cdceb2dcbbd04145208d0e1feb74e33.png

After he player defeats the boss, the boss will appear on a tale, the player can find a favorite angle to flatten the boss and generate a painting, along with the adventure log, it will be permanently recorded on the Adventure Monument.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/e6100e07c0bef2f2cdb4cbf139a13790754720d2.png

3. Added special rooms to the map
Added a variety of special rooms randomly appears in the map, some of the important ones are the blessing point. Where players can level up their hero, and the effects last until the end of the exploration.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/d16769de0dbbd13f25ade972142221fbb39c3bc9.png

Other than that, Ruins, Alchemy room, Hospital, Bank and Recreation room will be gradually added during the progress, not all of which may be completed.

4. Added the Hero Room 
Hero’s room, which appeared int he main screen, will now be integrated into the EA version. Players will be able to adjust the abilities of each hero by changing the decoration of each hero’s room.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603832/89c02248e3042ca7fa5aee71a428b3c4576aef9e.png

5. Integrate the Rune system after rework
The rune system has been reworked and integrated into EA

6. Improved hero selection interface and added contract level
The hero selection interface has been reworked and added new contract level. After complete a exploration you can challenge the higher difficulty for that hero.

7. Integrate the Gacha box
The gacha box is now available, players can earn gacha ticket during the exploration. You can get New minions,Trinkets, Hero furniture,Voxel, Play Tips, etc from the gacha box

8.  New heroes, minions, and items
New heroes, minions, and items will be added over time.

notes.title: Alpha1109 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone. Starting from this update, we will release the announcement of STEAM at the request of players, so that you can see the update more clearly.

There haven’t been any major updates recently, as we have spent a lot of time exploring the possibilities of multiplayer mode, and we are currently opening up a very immature version of battling mode for everyone to try out. If you have good ideas for multiplayer gameplay, you can share it with us in the steam community.

This update includes:

Adjustment of game rules:
Minions have updated with range attribute.
Minions can only attack the first target in the same column.
Monsters will now have their own formations, and more synergy among them.
Monsters will no longer move forward each turn, but instead attack the hero directly when there is no target.
Added more higher level Minions to choose from, the further you explore, the higher your chance to meet them.(green and blue)

Content update:

9 new Minions
8 new Monsters
8 new Events

Other:

Adjust some value.
Fixed a lot of bugs.
Optimized display and animation play speed.

After this update, we will focus on the content and quality of the game, accelerate the pace of content updates, and gradually update the UI, Visual effects, player experience and other aspects.
